test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 25 Jan 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: A person sells his table at a profit of 12(1)/(2)% and chair at a loss of 8(1)/(3)% but on the whole he gains Rs. 25. On the other hand, if he sells the table at a loss of 8(1)/(3)% and the chair at a profit of 12(1)/(2)% then he neither gains nor loses. Find the cost price of the table.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0a6c2db12945bba9d674d33112fce66b07f00093d75dae93749f9bdb7bd34e7a.png] **__Hint__**8(1)/(3)\% = 1/12

12(1)/(2)\% = 1/8

**Calculation:**

Let the CP of the table and chair be "T" and "C"

T × (1/12) = C × (1/8)

⇒ T / C = 12 / 8

⇒ T / C = 3 / 2

Again the CP of the table be 3x

And chair = 2x

3x × (1/8) - 2x × (1/12) = 25

⇒ (9x - 4x) / 24 = 25

⇒ 5x = 24 × 25

⇒ x = 24 × 5 = 120 

**The CP of table = 3x = 3 × 120 = Rs. 360**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **__Important Points__**Profit % = (Profit / CP) × 100%

Loss % = (Loss / CP) × 100%

SP = CP (100 + P)%

SP = CP (100 - L)%
